text:
maria.gonzalez: Quick follow-up to the onboarding RFC — propose splitting the bench step into 'preflight-mini' and 'full-bench'. Preflight = fast per-model checks that run inline at ingest (<=30s). Full-bench = heavy distributed runs. Thoughts?

ajay: +1 on splitting. We need a clear interface: preflight should return a small JSON fingerprint and a pass/fail score. No heavy model runs.

samantha: Agree. Also we should standardize the input shape for preflight to avoid tokenization edge-cases. Maybe always run 3 fixed prompts.

kevin: Concern: if preflight is too strict we block legitimate models. Suggest opt-in strictness levels on registry: permissive/standard/strict.

maria.gonzalez: Good point. We can keep a gating signal with enums and expose in UI + API.

ajay: Operationally, preflight must be stateless and cheap. Proposed schema:
```
{\n  \"model_id\": \"string\",\n  \"preflight_version\": \"v1\",\n  \"tokenization_fingerprint\": \"hex\",\n  \"smoke_scores\": { \"latency_ms\": \"number\", \"tok_per_sec\": \"number\" },\n  \"compat_flags\": [\"kv_cache_ok\",\"kv_concat_ok\"]\n}
```
Fields are small and optional. Keep the payload under 2KB.

bench-bot: preflight job queued: job_id=pf-20260301-42 status=running

bench-bot: preflight job complete: job_id=pf-20260301-42 status=pass latency_ms=28 tok_per_sec=520 compat_flags=[kv_cache_ok]

samantha: If bench-bot returns 'compat_flags' we can route onboarding: compatible models -> fast path, else route to full-bench.

lisa: How do we surface false positives? Preflight may miss quantization degeneracies that show up at scale.

maria.gonzalez: Plan: add a lightweight eval set for preflight plus a 'confidence' float. If confidence < 0.7 -> route to full-bench.

kevin: Also add TTL on preflight artifacts so we re-run if model binary or metadata changes.

ajay: For integration: runtime will call `POST /onboard/preflight?model=ID` and expect 200 + JSON within 30s. Fallback policy should be documented (timeouts -> trigger full-bench).

maria.gonzalez: Example error codes to include in the spec:
- 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED -> requires full-bench or manual review
- 200 with `route: fast` -> can proceed to fast onboarding path

We also need schemas for registry metadata; expose a `preflight_metadata` top-level field on model records.

samantha: UX: Console should show a preflight badge + confidence score and an action to 'trigger full benchmark'.

kevin: Perf tradeoffs: preflight can't measure steady-state batching or tail latency. We'll mark those metrics as 'estimated' and not use them for SLAs.

maria.gonzalez: Next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with interfaces and a proto for the JSON handshake. Anyone want to co-author? @ajay @samantha

ajay: I'll help with the job runner and the timeouts.

samantha: I'll add the eval prompts and small dataset, plus a script to generate deterministic tokenization fixtures.

bench-bot: created draft ticket T-1987: preflight + routing integration

maria.gonzalez: Thanks all. I'll post the RFC link here when ready. :thumbsup:
